tips.title: Tips for best results:
tips.tip1: Ensure your Excel file has clear headers in the first row
tips.tip2: Each row will generate a unique QR code containing all data from that record
tips.tip3: QR codes will contain all data from each column in the record
tips.tip4: You can export all QR codes as an organized PDF for printing and sharing
